notes.title: Cyber Chicken V 1.1. Update
notes.content:
[h1] Changelog:[/h1]

-Fixed an issue where the player was unable to use the world map after a certain point in the game.
-Adjusted the Mini-Vendor UI position which was too high.
-Fixed some inaccuracies in the way the world map renders its segments.
-Fixed certain inaccurate or bugged level transitions
-Fixed some stretched visuals in Salvaged City
-Fixed [spoiler] Lady Liberty's mouth not opening in Liberty's Tomb [/spoiler]
-Fixed some issues with inaccurate collision in certain levels.
-Blocked off an area that could lead the player out of bounds in Outskirts.
-Adjusted lighting and foreground objects in various levels to make the environment more readable.
-Reduced the accuracy of Molotov Cyberpunk enemies.
-Added an option in the menu for toggling V-Sync.

notes.title: Release Notes + More!
notes.content:
Hi,

Current patch notes: Fixed napalm charging UI. Fixed controller key rebinding. 

We are a very active dev team, committed to making Cyber Chicken an enjoyable and challenging experience for gamers of all skill. We encourage feedback, will fix bugs and incorporate player ideas that make the game even better!

Shout out to our awesome music and sound designer, Noam Guterman, for winning the Global Music Award for outstanding achievement in game music for Cyber Chicken!

WHOA! Team
